definition: 90 native nnU-Net baseline updates;10 batch-one training volumes gives9 volume-pass epochs.
selection_basis: User selected90 times the measured native nnU-Net baseline training-update cost, following exploratory learning curves. No outcome filtering; all24 runs reported.
schedule_policy: Keep each model baseline LR horizon fixed across every arm; stopping allowances are derived from measured objective and training-only calibration costs.
accounting: Established dense arithmetic, MAC=2. Forward/loss/backward/optimizer and calibration included; validation, augmentation, SDF target preprocessing, I/O, integer/boolean/comparison operations and precision housekeeping excluded.
